premise: I spent $68,000 of my late husband’s life insurance to fund my stepdaughter’s fertility treatments after she signed a contract promising to care for me in my old age; once she had her twins, she moved across the country and ghosted me, claiming I’d meant it as a gift—I sued for breach of contract, won a $95,000 judgment, and now garnish $800 monthly from her salary as a hospital executive to directly support my ‘Second Chance IVF’ support group for low-income women, with every check memo reading ‘Family Betrayal Fee.’
